shared_requirements.integration: Same accepted GLB must be used by board and character selector; standalone viewer alone is insufficient.
shared_requirements.prop_policy: Distinct props and accessories need identifiable objects/nodes; Alexia suitcase explicitly must be separate GLB. Extension of separate-object policy to other detachable props is a production recommendation.
shared_requirements.display_bases: All figures in master sit on circular silver display plinths. Treat these as reference presentation supports; do not fuse them into playable bodies.
shared_requirements.approval: User instruction to proceed authorizes reconstruction; it does not automatically visually approve generated meshes.
shared_requirements.prototype_manifest_gap: Current client/assets/characters/manifest.json lists only Alexia, Rindi, Kairo, Luna, Nox, Atlas and extremely simplified prototypes. Zeno, Yuna, Mochi, Pip exist in the 10-roster WIP sculpt set but have no entries in that prototype manifest.
